A List is used to store a group of values, each identified with a running index starting from 1. 

Think of it as a building (list) where each level (index) has a room that houses someone (value).

         

Lists are great for managing large amounts of data that change as the program runs.

The example below demonstrates how to create a list with values and display them on the LCD.
